## `accessibleWrapper`  *(utility · Core)*

Wraps a child with accessibility annotations (ARIA-style). See [`13_Accessibility.md`](13_Accessibility.md) for the full property set.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `announceNavigation` | `boolean` | no | — | Announce navigation changes through the screen reader. |
| `announceOnChange` | `boolean` | no | — | Announce the watched value whenever it changes. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | no | — | Move focus into this subtree when it appears. |
| `focusGroup` | `string` | no | — | Name of the focus group this subtree belongs to. Traversal moves through one group before leaving it, so the name is what ties siblings together.  |
| `focusOrder` | `number` | no | — | Position of this subtree in the focus order; lower comes first. |
| `liveRegion` | `string` | no | — | Announce updates inside the subtree without moving focus to it, at the named urgency — `polite` waits for a pause, `assertive` interrupts, `status` and `alert` carry the matching ARIA roles.  |
| `navigationMessage` | `string` | no | — | Message announced when navigation reaches this subtree. |
| `watchPath` | `string` | no | — | State path whose changes are announced (with `announceOnChange`). |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Wrapped subtree. |
| `accessibility` | `object` | no | — | `{ label, hint, role, live }` — mirrors §13. |

## `accordion`  *(layout · Core · v1.4)*

**Aliases:** `collapsible`

Sections that expand and collapse. `children` are the panels; each panel
declares its own `title` (or a `header` widget) and body.

Composing this from `conditional` + `inkWell` renders correctly and loses
two things the author cannot add back: the expand/collapse transition, and
the accessibility state a screen reader announces (expanded / collapsed,
and which control owns which region). A collapsed section that is merely
absent from the tree reads to assistive technology as content that does
not exist rather than content that is hidden.

`collapsible` is an alias for the single-section case — one panel with
`allowMultiple` irrelevant. It is the same widget, not a smaller one.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `panels` | `array<object>` | yes | — | `{ id, title?, header?, content, expanded?, enabled? }` entries. `header` (a Widget) wins over `title` when both are set. |
| `allowMultiple` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow more than one panel open at once. False collapses the previously open panel. |
| `expandedIds` | `array<string>` | no | — | Two-way bound list of open panel ids. Binding it makes expansion state addressable from actions. |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | no | true | Draw dividers between panels. |
| `icon` | `IconRef` | no | — | Expand indicator. Rotates on toggle. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "accordion",
  "allowMultiple": false,
  "panels": [
    { "id": "shipping", "title": "Shipping", "content": { "type": "text", "content": "Ships in 2 days" } },
    { "id": "returns", "title": "Returns", "content": { "type": "text", "content": "30 day window" } }
  ]
}
```

## `alertDialog`  *(dialog · Core · v1.0)*

**Aliases:** `alert`, `confirmDialog`

Modal alert with an optional title, an optional body (string or widget),
and a list of labeled action buttons. Dispatched via the `dialog` action
(`{ "type": "dialog", "dialog": { "type": "alertDialog", ... } }`). The
runtime renders it as a `Dialog` surface scoped to the current navigator
(not the root navigator), so tapping an action pops only the dialog.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `insetPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space between the dialog and the screen edges. |
| `scrollable` | `boolean` | no | — | Let the body scroll when it does not fit. |
| `clipBehavior` | `string` | no | — | How content crossing the bounds is clipped. |
| `shadowColor` | `Color` | no | — | Colour of the drop shadow cast by the surface. |
| `shape` | `object` | no | — | Outline of the surface, as a shape descriptor. |
| `surfaceTintColor` | `Color` | no | — | Elevation tint applied over the surface colour (M3). |
| `title` | `string` | no | — | Dialog title shown at the top. |
| `content` | `string | Widget` | no | — | Dialog body. When a string, rendered as a single `Text`. When a widget, rendered as-is. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether tapping outside the dialog closes it. |
| `onClose` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the dialog is dismissed without one of `actions[].onTap` being selected (e.g., outside-tap when `dismissible: true`, escape key). |
| `actions` | `array<object{ label: string, variant: string, primary: boolean, onTap: Action }>` | no | — | Action buttons rendered in the dialog footer. Each entry:   - `label` (required): button text.   - `variant`: one of `text` / `elevated` / `outlined` / `filled`; default `text`.   - `primary`: highlights the button as the default action.   - `onTap`: the action fired on press. The runtime pops the dialog     BEFORE executing `onTap`, so handlers that trigger state changes or     navigation do not race with the dialog dismissal.  |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | no | — | Where the dialog sits in the screen. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Legacy alias of `color`. |
| `elevation` | `Dimension` | no | — | Shadow depth of the dialog surface. |

### Examples

#### `basic_confirm`

Cancel / Confirm pair with a string body.


```json
{
  "type": "alertDialog",
  "title": "Delete item",
  "content": "This cannot be undone.",
  "actions": [
    { "label": "Cancel", "variant": "text" },
    { "label": "Delete", "variant": "filled", "primary": true }
  ]
}
```

#### `legacy_short_name`

Legacy `type: alert` accepted as alias for `alertDialog`.


```json
{ "type": "alert", "title": "Info", "content": "OK?" }
```

#### `unknown_variant_is_ok_for_now`

Phase 1 does not enforce `variant` enum on action entries; nested shape is permissive.


```json
{
  "type": "alertDialog",
  "actions": [ { "label": "Close", "variant": "ghost" } ]
}
```

#### `wrong_type` — **expected: validation_error** at `#/oneOf`

Root `type` must be `alertDialog` or alias.


```json
{ "type": "warning" }
```

Implicitly animates a child's `alignment` within its bounds. Use
for slide-from-edge / settle-to-position micro-interactions.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | yes | — | Target alignment. Changes are tweened. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `curve` | `AnimationCurve` | no | easeInOut | Easing curve. |
| `onEnd` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the animation completes. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Aligned child. |

### Examples

#### `slide_in_from_top_start`

```json

  "type": "animatedAlign",
  "alignment": "{{ready ? 'center' : 'topStart'}}",
  "duration": 400,
  "child": { "type": "icon", "icon": "check_circle" }
}
```

## `animatedContainer`  *(animation · Core)*

Container that implicitly animates property changes. Whenever any
of the size/decoration/alignment/padding fields change between
builds the runtime tweens between the old and new values over
`duration` using `curve`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `foregroundDecoration` | `BoxDecoration` | no | — | Decoration painted over the child. |
| `transform` | `array<number>` | no | — | 4×4 matrix applied to the box, in row-major order. |
| `transformAlignment` | `Alignment` | no | — | Origin the transform is applied about. |
| `clipBehavior` | `string` | no | — | How content crossing the bounds is clipped. |
| `constraints` | `object` | no | — | Minimum / maximum width and height the box may take. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `curve` | `AnimationCurve` | no | easeInOut | Easing curve. |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Animated width. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Animated height. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Animated inner padding. |
| `margin` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Animated outer margin. |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | no | — | Animated child alignment. |
| `decoration` | `BoxDecoration` | no | — | Animated decoration (color/gradient/border/shadow/image). |
| `onEnd` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the animation completes. |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | Animated child widget. |

### Examples

#### `expand_collapse`

```json
{
  "type": "animatedContainer",
  "duration": 500,
  "curve": "emphasized",
  "width": "{{expanded ? 300 : 100}}",
  "height": "{{expanded ? 200 : 50}}",
  "padding": { "all": 16 },
  "decoration": {
    "color": "{{expanded ? '#2196F3' : '#E0E0E0'}}",
    "borderRadius": 8
  },
  "onEnd": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "animationComplete", "value": true
  },
  "child": { "type": "center",
             "child": { "type": "text", "text": "Animated" } }
}
```

## `animatedDefaultTextStyle`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Implicitly animates the default `TextStyle` applied to descendant
`text` / `richText` widgets. Each style field (color, fontSize,
fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight, …) tweens independently.
Use for emphasis transitions (e.g., headline grows + bolds when
selected).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `style` | `TextStyle` | yes | — | Target text style. Changes are tweened. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `curve` | `AnimationCurve` | no | easeInOut | Easing curve. |
| `onEnd` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the animation completes. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Subtree whose default text style is tweened. |

### Examples

#### `emphasis_on_select`

```json
{
  "type": "animatedDefaultTextStyle",
  "style": {
    "fontSize": "{{selected ? 24 : 16}}",
    "fontWeight": "{{selected ? 'bold' : 'normal'}}",
    "color": "{{selected ? '#FF6B6B' : '#666666'}}"
  },
  "duration": 250,
  "child": { "type": "text", "text": "{{title}}" }
}
```

| `opacity` | `number` | yes | — | Target opacity in `[0, 1]`. Changes are tweened. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |

## `animatedPositioned`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Implicitly animates a child's edge offsets inside a `stack`. Same
contract as `positioned` (top/right/bottom/left/width/height) but
changes are tweened. Only valid as a `stack` child.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |

| `right` | `Dimension` | no | — | Distance from the parent stack's right edge. |
| `bottom` | `Dimension` | no | — | Distance from the parent stack's bottom edge. |
| `left` | `Dimension` | no | — | Distance from the parent stack's left edge. |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Animated width. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Animated height. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `curve` | `AnimationCurve` | no | easeInOut | Easing curve. |
| `onEnd` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the animation completes. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Positioned child widget. |

### Examples

#### `floating_button_settle`

```json
{
  "type": "stack",
  "children": [
    { "type": "image", "src": "{{cover}}" },
    {
      "type": "animatedPositioned",
      "right": 16,
      "bottom": "{{loaded ? 16 : -56}}",
      "duration": 400,
```

## `barcode`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Renders a 1-D barcode for `value`.

Like `qrCode`, the bar pattern is computed rather than laid out. Unlike it,
each `format` constrains what `value` may contain — an EAN-13 payload is
thirteen digits with a check digit, not arbitrary text.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `value` | `string | binding` | yes | — | Encoded payload. MUST satisfy the chosen `format`; a runtime reports a violation rather than rendering an unscannable image. |
| `format` | `string` | no | code128 | Symbology. `code128` accepts the widest payload and is the safe default. |
| `width` | `number` | no | — | Rendered width in logical pixels. Omitted means intrinsic — the natural width for the module count, which is what stays scannable. |
| `height` | `number` | no | 80 | Bar height. |
| `displayValue` | `boolean` | no | true | Print the payload under the bars. |
| `foregroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Bar color. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Background color. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{ "type": "barcode", "value": "4006381333931", "format": "ean13" }
```

## `box`  *(layout · Core · v1.0)*

**Aliases:** `container`, `constrained`, `decoratedBox`, `constrainedBox`

Generic single-child container that applies size, padding, margin, and a
decoration (background color, border, shadow, gradient, borderRadius). Most
commonly used as a styled wrapper around any child widget.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `constraints` | `object` | no | — | Minimum / maximum width and height the box may take. |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Fixed width — a number of logical pixels, or a `{value, unit}` object. When omitted, the box shrinks to its child's width. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Fixed height — a number of logical pixels, or a `{value, unit}` object. When omitted, the box shrinks to its child's height. |
| `minWidth` | `number` | no | — | Minimum width constraint. Honored independently of `width`; a child wider than `minWidth` is allowed. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | no | — | Maximum width constraint. Caps the child's width regardless of intrinsic size. |
| `minHeight` | `number` | no | — | Minimum height constraint. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | no | — | Maximum height constraint. |
| `padding` | `BoxSpacing` | no | — | Space inside the box, between the border and the child. Accepts an M3 spacing token shorthand (`xxs` / `xs` / `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl` / `2xl` / `3xl` / `4xl`, or any custom slot in `theme.spacing`) — resolved through `theme.spacing.<token>` to a uniform inset — the `{token}` object form, or any EdgeInsets spelling.  |
| `margin` | `BoxSpacing` | no | — | Space outside the box, between the box and its parent. Takes the same spellings as `padding`, token included — the widget resolves both through one helper, so declaring less here only made the token unauthorable, never unrenderable.  |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | no | — | Alignment of the child inside the box when the box is larger than the child. See the `Alignment` primitive for the canonical 9-token directional set and the `{x, y}` numeric form.  |
| `color` *(aliases: `backgroundColor`)* | `Color` | no | — | Solid background color. Shorthand for `decoration.color`; mutually exclusive with `decoration`. |
| `decoration` | `BoxDecoration` | no | — | Visual decoration. Mutually exclusive with the top-level `color` shorthand — when both are present `decoration` wins. See the `BoxDecoration` $def for the full property set: `color`, `gradient`, `image`, `border`, `borderRadius`, `boxShadow`, `shape`, `backdropBlur`.  |

### Children

- kind: `single` · key: `child`

### Examples

#### `sized_decorated_no_child`

Sized + decorated + padded, without a child. Validates via schema alone.


```json
{
  "type": "box",
  "width": 200,
  "height": 80,
  "padding": { "all": 12 },
  "decoration": { "color": "#2196F3", "borderRadius": 8 }
}
```

#### `child_is_box`

Child is another `box`. Self-contained within the Phase 1 registry.


```json
{
  "type": "box",
  "child": { "type": "box", "width": 40, "height": 40, "color": "#FF4081" }
}
```

#### `unknown_type` — **expected: validation_error** at `#/oneOf`

`type` value must be `box` or a declared alias.


```json
{ "type": "not-a-real-widget" }
```

## `breadcrumb`  *(navigation · Core · v1.4)*

Trail of ancestor locations ending at the current one. Composable from
`linear` + `text` + navigate actions, but composing it loses the landmark
role assistive technology uses to skip to it, and every author re-decides
where the separator goes and whether the last item is a link (it is not).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `items` | `array<object>` | yes | — | `{ label, route?, params?, icon? }` in ancestor-first order. The final entry is the current location and MUST NOT be rendered as a link even if it carries a `route`. |
| `separator` | `string` | no | / | Glyph between entries. Decorative — hidden from assistive technology. |
| `maxItems` | `number` | no | — | Collapse the middle of a long trail behind an overflow control, keeping the first and last. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "breadcrumb",
  "items": [
    { "label": "Home", "route": "/" },
    { "label": "Orders", "route": "/orders" },
    { "label": "#1042" }
  ]
}
```

Interactive button. The canonical label field is `label`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |

```json
  "type": "button",
```

## `canvas`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.3)*

General-purpose vector drawing via an ordered command array. All numeric and color properties support binding expressions, enabling data-driven graphics (progress rings, custom indicators, composable chart primitives).
backgroundColor:
  type: Color
  description: "Legacy alias of `color`."

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Measured from real documents (2026-08-04): number, `{value, unit}`, a dimension string or a binding. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "canvas",
  "width": 300,
  "height": 200,
  "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF",
  "commands": [
    { "op": "rect", "x": 10, "y": 10, "width": 100, "height": 80,
      "fill": "#FF5722", "cornerRadius": 8 },
    { "op": "circle", "cx": 200, "cy": 100, "radius": 40,
      "fill": "{{app.color}}", "stroke": "#333333", "strokeWidth": 2 },
    { "op": "arc", "cx": 60, "cy": 150, "radius": 30,
      "startAngle": 3.14, "endAngle": "{{3.14 + (app.progress / 100) * 3.14}}",
      "stroke": "#4CAF50", "strokeWidth": 4, "strokeCap": "round" },
    { "op": "line", "x1": 10, "y1": 190, "x2": 290, "y2": 190,
      "stroke": "#E0E0E0", "strokeWidth": 1 },
    { "op": "path", "d": "M 10 10 L 90 10 L 90 90 Z",
      "fill": "rgba(33,150,243,0.2)", "stroke": "#2196F3", "strokeWidth": 1 },
    { "op": "text", "text": "{{app.label}}", "x": 10, "y": 180,
      "fontSize": 14, "color": "#333333", "textAlign": "start" },
    { "op": "image", "src": "bundle://icons/logo.png",
      "x": 250, "y": 10, "width": 40, "height": 40, "opacity": 0.9 }
  ]
}
```

## `carousel`  *(list · Core · v1.3)*

Horizontally scrolling browser with optional partial-viewport
framing (cover-flow / album-shelf style). Distinct from `pageView`
(which always snaps a full viewport per page) — `carousel` lets
authors set `viewportFraction` < 1 so adjacent items peek in,
signalling "more to scroll". Used for content shelves (book
covers, album browsers, magazine front pages).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `items` | `array | binding` | no | — | Array source. Required when `children` is omitted. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Widget` | no | — | Template rendered per bound item. Required with `items`. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | no | — | Static slides. Mutually exclusive with `items` + `itemTemplate`. |
| `scrollDirection` | `string` | no | horizontal | Scroll axis. |
| `viewportFraction` | `number` | no | 1.0 | Each slide's width as a fraction of the carousel width. `1.0` = one item fills the viewport (matches `pageView`); `0.85` leaves both neighbours peeking; `0.6` shows three items.  |
| `loop` | `boolean` | no | false | When true the list wraps around — last → first → last. |
| `autoPlay` | `boolean | number | binding` | no | — | When set, advances one item every `autoPlay` ms. Authors typically pair with `loop: true`.  |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | no | 0 | Index of the slide rendered first. |
| `transition` | `string` | no | slide | Per-slide transition. `slide` is the default linear scroll; `fade` cross-fades between slides at the same position; `coverflow` rotates and depth-shifts neighbours; `depth` scales/translates Z-axis. `coverflow`/`depth` need a perspective-aware compositor — runtimes without it fall back to `slide`.  |
| `indicatorPosition` | `string` | no | bottom | Page indicator dot bar. |
| `onPageChanged` | `Action` | no | — | Fires after the active slide settles. `event.page` carries the new index. |

### Examples

#### `book_shelf`

```json
{
  "type": "carousel",
  "items": "{{books}}",
  "viewportFraction": 0.7,
  "loop": true,
  "autoPlay": 4000,
  "transition": "coverflow",
  "indicatorPosition": "bottom",
  "itemTemplate": {
    "type": "card",
    "child": {
      "type": "image", "src": "{{item.cover}}", "fit": "cover"
    }
  }
}
```

## `checkbox`  *(input · Core)*

Boolean checkbox. Shared rows per §2.6.0; `value` is `boolean`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |

| `label` | `string` | no | — | Optional label. |

## `combobox`  *(input · Core · v1.4)*

**Aliases:** `autocomplete`

Text entry with suggestions. Shared rows per §2.6.0; `binding` holds the
**typed string**, not an option id.

The defining property is that a value outside `options` is legal — that
is what separates it from `select` / `multiSelect`, where the option list
is the domain. Composing it from `textInput` + a list loses focus
ownership: the list must not steal focus from the field, arrow keys must
move a highlight without moving the caret, and Escape must close the list
without clearing the text. Those are one widget's job.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label shown beside or above the control. |
| `options` *(aliases: `items`)* | `array<Option>` | no | — | Suggestions. Optional — a combobox with none is a plain text field until `onSearch` supplies them. |
| `allowCustom` | `boolean` | no | true | Accept a value not present in `options`. Setting it false makes this a searchable `select`. |
| `onSearch` | `Action` | no | — | Fired as the user types, for server-side suggestion lookup. The action writes `options`; the runtime does not re-filter what it returns. |
| `minChars` | `number` | no | 1 | Characters typed before suggestions are requested or shown. |
| `debounceMs` | `number` | no | 250 | Idle time before `onSearch` fires. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | — | Placeholder text. |

### Examples

#### `server_backed`

```json
{
  "type": "combobox",
  "binding": "form.city",
  "minChars": 2,
  "onSearch": { "type": "tool", "tool": "searchCities", "params": { "q": "{{event.query}}" } }
}
```

## `conditional`  *(layout · Core)*

Renders different branches based on an expression. Two forms are supported: then/else and multi-branch (`switch`/`cases`).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `condition` | `boolean | binding` | no | — | Boolean literal or boolean-producing expression (then/else form). |
| `then` *(aliases: `child`, `widget`)* | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when `condition` is truthy (then/else form). |
| `else` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when `condition` is falsy (then/else form). |
| `switch` | `binding` | no | — | Expression whose value is compared against each case (switch form). |
| `cases` | `array` | no | — | List of `{ value, child }` entries (switch form). |
| `default` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when no case matches (switch form). |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "conditional",
  "condition": "{{user.isAuthenticated}}",
  "then": { "type": "text", "text": "Welcome, {{user.name}}!" },
  "else": {
    "type": "button",
    "label": "Sign In",
    "onTap": { "type": "navigation", "action": "push", "route": "/login" }
  }
}
```

#### `prose_example_1`

```json
{
  "type": "conditional",
  "switch": "{{status}}",
  "cases": [
    { "value": "loading", "child": { "type": "progressBar" } },
    { "value": "error",   "child": { "type": "text", "text": "Error: {{errorMessage}}" } },
    { "value": "empty",   "child": { "type": "text", "text": "No data available" } }
  ],
  "default": { "type": "text", "text": "Ready" }
}
```

## `contextMenu`  *(interaction · Core · v1.4)*

Menu raised by secondary activation on its `child` — right-click, long
press, or the platform's context key.

This cannot be composed: the gesture that raises it is platform-specific
(and on touch competes with scroll and text selection), and the menu must
appear at the pointer rather than against the child's box. A
`gestureDetector` wrapping a `popupMenuButton` gets neither.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Widget the gesture applies to. |
| `items` | `array<object>` | yes | — | `{ key, label, icon?, enabled?, divider?, children? }`. `divider: true` renders a separator and carries no action. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | When false the child renders normally and the gesture falls through to the platform. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelect` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "contextMenu",
  "child": { "type": "text", "content": "{{item.name}}" },
  "items": [
    { "key": "rename", "label": "Rename", "icon": "edit" },
    { "key": "sep", "divider": true },
    { "key": "delete", "label": "Delete", "icon": "delete" }
  ]
}
```

Dialog with arbitrary widget content.

| `insetPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space between the dialog and the screen edges. |

Renders a compact dashboard tile — the widget equivalent of the `ApplicationDefinition.dashboard` field (see [`11_Bundle_Metadata.md`](11_Bundle_Metadata.md) §11). Used to embed a dashboard-mode tile inside a page (launcher / app grid scenarios).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `content` | `Widget` | no | — | Dashboard tile content tree. When omitted the tile renders empty (fallback). |
| `refreshInterval` | `number` | no | — | Auto-refresh period in milliseconds. Omit for static tiles. |

## `dataTable`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.0)*

**Aliases:** `dataGrid`

Material-style sortable, selectable data table bound to a row array.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `editable` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow in-place cell editing. Edits report through `onCellEdit`; the widget does not mutate `data` on its own. |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | no | false | Offer per-column filter controls. |
| `resizableColumns` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow dragging column edges to resize. |
| `virtualScroll` | `boolean` | no | false | Render only visible rows. Requires a fixed `rowHeight` — a virtualised list cannot measure rows it has not built. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` | no | — | Fixed row height in logical pixels. Required when `virtualScroll` is true. |
| `columns` | `array<Column>` | yes | — | Column definitions |
| `columns[].key` | `string` | yes | — | Row field key |
| `columns[].label` | `string` | yes | — | Header label |
| `columns[].width` | `number` | no | — | Fixed column width |
| `columns[].sortable` | `boolean` | no | false | Whether column supports sorting |
| `columns[].align` | `string` | no | start | Horizontal text alignment. |
| `rows` | `array<object> | binding` | yes | — | Array of row objects |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | no | false | Whether rows are selectable |
| `sortColumn` | `string` | no | — | Current sort column key. Declared `binding` before, which accepted `"{{sortColumn}}"` and rejected the key itself — a table sorted by a fixed column could not say so.  |
| `sortAscending` | `boolean` | no | true | Current sort direction. `true` is ascending. Declared `binding` before, so writing the direction as the boolean the runtime reads was rejected at load.  |
| `onSort` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on header tap of a sortable column |
| `onCellEdit` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when an edited cell is committed. `event.row` is the row object, `event.column` its column key, `event.value` the new value and `event.previous` the old one. The widget does not mutate `rows` — the document decides what an edit means.  |
| `onRowTap` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on row tap; `event.row` is the row object |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "dataTable",
  "columns": [
    { "key": "id", "label": "ID", "width": 100 },
    { "key": "name", "label": "Name", "sortable": true },
    { "key": "status", "label": "Status", "align": "center" }
  ],
  "rows": "{{items}}",
  "selectable": true,
  "sortColumn": "{{sortColumn}}",
  "sortAscending": "{{sortAscending}}",
  "onSort": {
    "type": "batch",
    "actions": [
      { "type": "state", "action": "set", "binding": "sortColumn", "value": "{{event.column}}" },
      { "type": "state", "action": "set", "binding": "sortAscending", "value": "{{event.ascending}}" }
    ]
  },
  "onRowTap": {
    "type": "navigation",
    "action": "push",
    "route": "/detail/{{event.row.id}}"
  }
}
```

## `dateRangePicker`  *(input · Core)*

Date range selection. Exception to §2.6.0: instead of a single `binding`, the range is bound via **two separate properties** — `startDate` and `endDate` — each independently following §2.6.0 two-way semantics (each accepts a literal ISO string, a `{{path}}` expression for read-only display, or a plain state-path string for two-way binding). `firstDate`/`lastDate` remain one-way constraints on the allowed range.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the picker accepts user input. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the range changes. Receives `{{event.value}}` as `{ start, end }`. |
| `errorText` | `string` | no | — | Error message shown under the field. Overrides validation output. |
| `startDate` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the range's start (ISO date). |
| `endDate` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the range's end (ISO date). |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label. |
| `firstDate` | `string` | no | — | Earliest allowed date (constraint, one-way). |
| `lastDate` | `string` | no | — | Latest allowed date (constraint, one-way). |
| `format` | `string` | no | yyyy-MM-dd | Display format. |
| `locale` | `string` | no | — | Locale identifier. |
| `change` | `Action` | no | — | Legacy alias of `onChange`. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "dateRangePicker",
  "startDate": "filter.from",
  "endDate": "filter.to",
  "firstDate": "2026-01-01",
  "lastDate": "2026-12-31"
}
```

## `dateTimePicker`  *(input · Core · v1.4)*

Single instant — date and time chosen together. Shared rows per §2.6.0;
`binding` holds one ISO-8601 timestamp.

Not `datePicker` + `timePicker` side by side: those bind two values the
author must then recombine, and the recombination is where time zones get
lost. One widget, one instant, one binding.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label shown beside or above the control. |
| `min` | `string` | no | — | Earliest selectable instant (ISO-8601). |
| `max` | `string` | no | — | Latest selectable instant (ISO-8601). |
| `dateFormat` | `string` | no | — | Display pattern for the date portion. Display only — the bound value stays ISO-8601. |
| `timeFormat` | `string` | no | — | Display pattern for the time portion. Display only. |
| `minuteInterval` | `number` | no | 1 | Granularity of the minute wheel. |
| `timeZone` | `string` | no | — | IANA zone the picker presents in. Absent means the host's zone. The bound value carries its offset either way — a timestamp without one is not an instant. |

```json
{ "type": "dateTimePicker", "binding": "booking.startsAt", "minuteInterval": 15 }
```

Wraps a child with a decoration box (color, gradient, border, shadow,
image, blur) without otherwise affecting layout. The full
`BoxDecoration` may be supplied via `decoration:`, or any of its

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |

| `position` | `string` | no | — | Where the decoration sits relative to the child: `background` or `foreground`. |
| `decoration` | `BoxDecoration` | no | — | Full decoration object. Alternatively, the constituent fields (`color`, `gradient`, `image`, `border`, `borderRadius`, `boxShadow`, `shape`, `backdropBlur`) may appear flat at the top level. Flat keys override matching `decoration.<field>` entries.  |
| `color` | `Color` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.color`. |
| `borderRadius` | `BorderRadius` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.borderRadius`. |
| `border` | `BoxBorder` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.border`. |
| `gradient` | `Gradient` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.gradient`. |
| `image` | `BackgroundImage` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.image`. |
| `boxShadow` | `array<BoxShadow>` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.boxShadow`. |
| `shape` | `string` | no | rectangle | Flat shorthand for `decoration.shape`. |
| `backdropBlur` | `number` | no | — | Flat shorthand for `decoration.backdropBlur` (Gaussian blur sigma). |

## `diffViewer`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Side-by-side or unified comparison of two texts.

Separate from `codeEditor` rather than a mode on it, because the input is
two documents: a `mode` flag on a single-value widget would leave one of
the two with nowhere to bind. Read-only by design — editing a diff means
editing one side, which is `codeEditor`'s job.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `oldValue` | `string | binding` | yes | — | Left / base text. |
| `newValue` | `string | binding` | yes | — | Right / changed text. |
| `splitView` | `boolean` | no | true | Two columns when true, unified single column when false. |
| `language` | `string` | no | — | Syntax highlighting language, same vocabulary as `codeEditor.language`. |
| `showLineNumbers` | `boolean` | no | true | Gutter line numbers. |
| `contextLines` | `number` | no | — | Unchanged lines kept around each change. Omitted shows the whole document. |
| `highlightLines` | `array<number>` | no | — | Extra emphasis on specific new-side lines. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{ "type": "diffViewer", "oldValue": "{{rev.before}}", "newValue": "{{rev.after}}", "language": "json" }
```

## `fileInput`  *(input · Core · v1.4)*

Lets the user hand the application a file they picked themselves.

Follows the shared input contract (spec §2.6.0): with `binding` set, the
runtime writes the selection to that state path. The value written is a
list of file descriptors — see `binding` below.

**Why this is Core and `client.selectFile` is not.** Reading a path the
document names (`client.readFile`, `client.listFiles` — spec §8.2) reaches
into the host's filesystem, so it belongs to the Client Profile behind a
`file.read` grant (spec §8.4). Receiving a file the *user chose in a picker* is the
opposite: the choosing is the consent, and the app learns nothing it was
not handed. It is the same trust level as `signature` (also Core), which
already accepts user-drawn input. A browser-rendered app that cannot claim
the Client Profile still must be able to accept an upload.

A runtime MUST NOT use this widget as a path to unpicked files: only what
the picker returned is readable, and `path` MAY be absent (it is on web).
Transport is not this widget's concern — once the selection is in state,
sending it is an ordinary `tool` action.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path the selection is written to. Receives an array of `{name, size, mimeType, bytes?, path?}` — `bytes` is a base64 `data:` URI usable directly as an `AssetRef`, `path` is present only where the host has a filesystem. Empty array when the user cancels.  |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the picker can be opened. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired after a selection lands in state. |
| `dragDrop` | `boolean` | no | true | Accept files dropped onto the control where the host supports it. Never the only affordance — the picker button stays. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | no | — | Ceiling on selection count. Ignored unless `multiple` is true. |
| `preview` | `boolean` | no | false | Render thumbnails for image selections, using each descriptor's `bytes` as an `AssetRef`. |
| `crop` | `boolean` | no | false | Offer a crop step for image selections before the value lands in state. |
| `aspectRatio` | `number` | no | — | Crop ratio (width / height). Ignored unless `crop` is true. |
| `accept` | `array<string>` | no | — | Acceptable types as MIME patterns (`image/*`, `application/pdf`) or extensions (`.csv`). A hint to the picker, not a guarantee — a runtime MUST re-check `mimeType` before relying on it.  |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow selecting more than one file. |
| `maxBytes` | `number` | no | — | Per-file size ceiling. Files above it are rejected before entering state and MUST surface through `onError`, not silently vanish.  |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Text on the picker trigger. |
| `onError` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the picker fails, a file exceeds `maxBytes`, or the host has no picker at all. A host that cannot pick MUST report here rather than render a control that does nothing.  |

### Examples

#### `image_upload`

```json
{
  "type": "fileInput",
  "binding": "form.photo",
  "accept": ["image/*"],
  "maxBytes": 5242880,
  "label": "Choose a photo"
}
```

#### `render_the_picked_image`

The descriptor's `bytes` is a `data:` URI, so it is a valid `AssetRef`
and needs no upload round-trip to be shown.



```json
{
  "type": "image",
  "src": "{{form.photo[0].bytes}}",
  "width": 200
}
```

## `gantt`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Tasks on a time axis, with dependencies and progress.

What makes this a widget rather than a composition is the axis. Bars are
positioned by *time*, not by index, so the row and the header must share
one scale, stay aligned through zoom and horizontal scroll, and place a
task whose span is shorter than a pixel without dropping it. Composing it
from `grid` gives rows that drift from the header as soon as either
scrolls.

Dependencies are drawn, not enforced: the widget renders the arrows and
reports an edit, and whether a move is legal is the server's answer.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `tasks` | `array<object> | binding` | yes | — | `{ id, label, start, end, progress?, dependsOn?, group?, color? }`. `start`/`end` are ISO-8601. `dependsOn` holds task ids. |
| `viewMode` | `string` | no | day | Axis granularity. |
| `range` | `object` | no | — | `{ start, end }` window shown. Omitted fits all tasks. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow dragging bars to move them and dragging edges to reschedule. |
| `showProgress` | `boolean` | no | true | Render each task's `progress` as a fill. |
| `showDependencies` | `boolean` | no | true | Draw dependency arrows. |
| `todayMarker` | `boolean` | no | true | Mark the current instant on the axis. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` | no | — | Task row height in logical pixels. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onTaskChange` | — | — |
| `onTaskClick` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "gantt",
  "tasks": "{{plan.tasks}}",
  "viewMode": "week",
  "editable": true,
  "onTaskChange": { "type": "tool", "tool": "rescheduleTask", "params": { "id": "{{event.id}}", "start": "{{event.start}}", "end": "{{event.end}}" } }
}
```

| `valueColor` | `Color` | no | theme primary | Value arc color (when no segments) |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | no | true | Show numeric label |
| `labelFormat` | `string` | no | {value}% | Label pattern; `{value}` is replaced by the reading. The default carries the per-cent sign because that is what every gauge written so far has been drawing — a gauge of something else writes its own pattern.  |
| `startAngle` | `number` | no | -220 | Start angle in degrees, measured the way the painter does: `-220` with a sweep of `260` is the open-bottom dial these gauges have always drawn.  |
| `sweepAngle` | `number` | no | 260 | Sweep span in degrees. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "gauge",
  "value": 72,
  "min": 0,
  "max": 100,
  "segments": [
    { "from": 0, "to": 30, "color": "#F44336" },
    { "from": 30, "to": 70, "color": "#FF9800" },
    { "from": 70, "to": 100, "color": "#4CAF50" }
  ],
  "size": 200,
  "strokeWidth": 20,

  "labelFormat": "{value}%",
  "startAngle": 135,
  "sweepAngle": 270
}
```

## `heatmap`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.0)*

Two-dimensional heatmap visualization.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `cellGap` | `Dimension` | no | — | Gap between adjacent cells. |
| `colorScheme` | `string` | no | — | Named colour ramp used between `minValue` and `maxValue`. |
| `columns` | `number` | no | — | Number of columns the values are laid out in. |
| `maxValue` | `number` | no | — | Value mapped to the high end of the colour range. Optional — when omitted the range is taken from the data, so a heatmap always renders as a scale rather than one flat block. |
| `minValue` | `number` | no | — | Value mapped to the low end of the colour range. Optional — when omitted the range is taken from the data. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | no | — | Show the row and column labels declared in `rowLabels` / `columnLabels`. Off by default: without it those labels draw nothing, and an author who declared them reads the blank axis as their own mistake. The numeric value inside a cell is `showValues`. |

| `colorRange.low` | `Color` | no | — | Color at the low end of the range. |
| `colorRange.high` | `Color` | no | — | Color at the high end of the range. |
| `showValues` | `boolean` | no | true | Render the numeric value inside each cell. On by default: every heatmap written before this property was read showed its numbers, and turning them off by default would change what those documents display.  |
| `onCellTap` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on cell tap; `event.row`, `event.column`, `event.value` |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "heatmap",
  "data": "{{heatmapData}}",
  "columnLabels": ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"],
  "rowLabels": ["Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening"],
```

## `hero`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Shared-element transition wrapper. Wrap a child widget on the
source page AND on the destination page with the SAME `tag`; the
runtime morphs the source widget's bounds → destination widget's
bounds during the route transition (cover → detail magnification,
album cover → expanded album view). Pairs naturally with
`RouteTransition` styles such as `fade` or `sharedAxis`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `tag` | `string` | yes | — | Identifier shared between source and destination pages. Both sides MUST set the same tag for the morph to engage. Tags must be unique within each page (a single page cannot have two heroes with the same tag).  |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | The widget that morphs across the route boundary. |
| `transitionOnUserGestures` | `boolean` | no | false | When true, also morphs during gesture-driven back navigation (iOS swipe-from-edge). Adds slight render cost.  |
| `flightShuttleBuilder` | `Widget` | no | — | Optional intermediate widget used during the morph itself. When omitted the runtime tweens between the source and destination children.  |

### Examples

#### `cover_to_detail`

```json
{
  "type": "hero",
  "tag": "album-{{album.id}}",
  "child": {
    "type": "image",
    "src": "{{album.cover}}",
    "fit": "cover"
  }
}
```

## `icon`  *(display · Core)*

Displays an icon. The `icon` property accepts three source forms — pick
the lightest option that fits the asset:

1. **Named (built-in)** — `"home"`, `"folder_open"`, … from the runtime's
   Material Icons resolver table. Zero-cost.
2. **Codepoint** — `{codepoint, fontFamily?, fontPackage?}` for Material
   Icons codepoints not in the name table.
3. **Any `AssetRef`** — a network URL, `bundle://` asset, `assets/` path,
   `data:image/svg+xml;…` inline SVG, `client://` host resource, or an
   `{uri, origin?}` object read from an origin. Which of these a given
   runtime resolves is declared, not assumed (`06_Runtime_Contract.md`
   §6.12).

A bare string that matches no known scheme and is not an `assets/` path
is read as a **name**, so the named form stays the zero-ceremony default.

The optional `shader` field paints the icon with a gradient/shader fill
(rather than a solid `color`). When both are set the shader wins.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `icon` | `IconRef` | yes | — | Icon name, codepoint object, or any `AssetRef` — the same three forms every icon slot accepts.  |
| `size` | `string` | no | — | Icon size. Accepts either a numeric dp value or an `AppIconSizes` token shorthand (`sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`) which scales with the active form factor.  |
| `sizeToken` | `string` | no | — | Responsive icon-size token. Equivalent to passing the same string via `size`; resolves through `AppIconSizes.of(context)` and tracks the form-factor scale (compact / medium / desktop / embedded).  |
| `color` | `Color` | no | — | Icon color. Applied to named / codepoint / SVG forms; for raster `URL` form it tints when supported. Ignored when `shader` is set.  |
| `shader` | `Gradient` | no | — | Gradient/shader fill (linear / radial / sweep). Painted via a shader mask over the icon's glyph alpha. Mutually exclusive with `color` — when both are present `shader` wins.  |

### Examples

#### `named`

```json
{ "type": "icon", "icon": "home", "size": 24, "color": "#2196F3" }
```

#### `codepoint`

```json
{ "type": "icon", "icon": { "codepoint": 59530 }, "size": 24 }
```

#### `url_raster`

```json
{ "type": "icon", "icon": "https://example.com/icon.png", "size": 32 }
```

#### `bundle_svg`

```json
{ "type": "icon", "icon": "assets/icons/heart.svg", "size": 32 }
```

#### `gradient_shader`

Icon painted with a linear gradient instead of a solid color.


```json
{
  "type": "icon",
  "icon": "favorite",
  "size": 48,
  "shader": {
    "type": "linear",
    "colors": ["#FF6B6B", "#FFD93D"],
    "begin": "topStart",
    "end": "bottomEnd"
  }
}
```

Displays an image from any asset source the runtime resolves — a
network URL, the active bundle, inline bytes, a host resource, or a
resource served by an origin. See `AssetRef`; a runtime declares which
of those it resolves (`06_Runtime_Contract.md` §6.12) and routes the
rest to `fallback` / `fallbackUrl` / `fallbackBehavior`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `errorWidget` | `string` | no | — | Text shown on the error tile when nothing resolves. |
| `fallbackBehavior` | `string` | no | — | What to draw when nothing resolves: `error` (default) or `hide`. |
| `fallbackUrl` | `AssetRef` | no | — | Second source tried when the first cannot be resolved (§6.12.4). |
| `src` *(aliases: `source`, `backgroundImage`)* | `AssetRef` | yes | — | Image source. Any `AssetRef` form. |
| `width` | `number` | no | — | Width in logical pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | no | — | Height in logical pixels. |
| `fit` | `string` | no | contain | `cover`, `contain`, `fill`, `none`, `scaleDown`, `fitHeight`, `fitWidth`. |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | no | center | Alignment within bounds. |
| `fallback` | `Widget` | no | — | Widget drawn when the source cannot be resolved (§6.12.4). |
| `loading` | `Widget` | no | — | Widget drawn while the source is being read. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | — | Placeholder text. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "image",
  "src": "https://example.com/image.png",
  "width": 200,
  "height": 150,
  "fit": "cover"
```

## `imageFilter`  *(display · Core · v1.3)*

Wraps a child with a colour / blur filter. Distinct from
`BoxDecoration.image.colorFilter` (which colours an image
background) — `imageFilter` filters the entire rendered subtree.
Use for sepia/grayscale book pages, blur-on-hover thumbnails,
saturation-bumped hero shots.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `filter` | `string` | yes | — | Filter kind: - `sepia` — warm-tone tint mimicking aged photograph. - `grayscale` — desaturate to luminance. - `blur` — Gaussian blur (sigma controlled by `intensity`). - `saturation` — multiply chroma by `intensity` (0 = grayscale, 1 = unchanged, >1 = pop). - `brightness` — multiply luminance. - `contrast` — increase / decrease contrast. - `invert` — colour invert (negative).  |
| `intensity` | `number` | no | 1.0 | Filter strength. Range and default depend on `filter`: - `sepia` / `grayscale` / `invert` — `0.0` (off) .. `1.0` (full). Default `1.0`. - `blur` — sigma in pixels (`0.0` off, typical 4..16). - `saturation` / `brightness` / `contrast` — multiplier (`1.0` unchanged).  |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Filtered subtree. |

### Examples

#### `sepia_book_page`

```json
{
  "type": "imageFilter",
  "filter": "sepia",
  "intensity": 0.7,
  "child": {
    "type": "image",
    "src": "{{chapter.illustration}}",
    "fit": "cover"
  }
}
```

#### `blur_on_inactive`

```json
{
  "type": "imageFilter",
  "filter": "blur",
  "intensity": "{{active ? 0 : 8}}",
  "child": { "type": "image", "src": "{{cover}}" }
}
```

## `kanban`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Cards in columns, moved between columns by dragging.

Composable from `grid` + `draggable` + `dragTarget` in the sense that the
pieces exist — and that composition is where the work actually is. Drop
targets must be the gaps between cards rather than the cards themselves,
the column must auto-scroll while a card hovers near its edge, and a drop
must report *where* in the destination the card landed, not just that it
moved. Authors composing this get a board that looks right and reorders
wrongly.

The widget owns presentation and gesture. It does **not** own the move:
`onCardMove` reports the intent and the author's action decides, so a
server-rejected move is not silently already applied on screen.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `columns` | `array<object> | binding` | yes | — | `{ key, title, items, limit?, color? }`. `limit` caps a column's card count — a drop that would exceed it is refused at the gesture, not after. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Widget` | yes | — | Card body. Rendered per item with `item` in scope, exactly as `list.itemTemplate`. |
| `itemKey` | `string` | no | id | Field identifying a card. Stable identity is what makes a move addressable. |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether cards can be moved at all. False renders a read-only board. |
| `columnWidth` | `Dimension` | no | — | Fixed column width. Omitted distributes available width. |
| `optimistic` | `boolean` | no | false | Move the card on screen before `onCardMove` resolves. False keeps the board as the truth the server confirmed — the safer default when a move can be rejected. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onCardMove` | — | — |
| `onCardClick` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "kanban",
  "columns": "{{board.columns}}",
  "itemKey": "id",
  "itemTemplate": { "type": "card", "child": { "type": "text", "content": "{{item.title}}" } },
  "onCardMove": { "type": "tool", "tool": "moveCard", "params": { "id": "{{event.item.id}}", "to": "{{event.to.column}}", "index": "{{event.to.index}}" } }
}
```

## `kenBurnsImage`  *(display · Core · v1.3)*

Image with an automatic slow zoom-and-pan animation (the "Ken
Burns effect"). Used for cinematic stills in book chapter
openings, landing pages, and slideshow frames. The image holds
intrinsic resolution and is animated within fit-bounds — no
cropping outside the rendered rectangle.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `src` | `AssetRef` | yes | — | Image source. |
| `duration` | `Dimension` | no | 8000 | Total animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `intensity` | `number` | no | 0.15 | Zoom amount. The image zooms from 1.0 to (1.0 + `intensity`) across `duration`. Practical range: `0.05` (subtle) .. `0.30` (dramatic).  |
| `startAlignment` | `Alignment` | no | topStart | Pan start position within the rendered bounds. |
| `endAlignment` | `Alignment` | no | bottomEnd | Pan end position within the rendered bounds. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | no | true | When true the animation reverses and replays continuously; when false it stops at the end position. |
| `curve` | `AnimationCurve` | no | linear | Easing curve over the zoom/pan progression. |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Render width. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Render height. |
| `fit` | `string` | no | cover | How the image scales to its render bounds before the Ken Burns animation overlays. |

### Examples

#### `chapter_opener`

```json
{
  "type": "kenBurnsImage",
  "src": "{{chapter.cover}}",
  "duration": 12000,
  "intensity": 0.2,
  "startAlignment": "topStart",
  "endAlignment": "bottomEnd",
  "loop": true,
  "width": 800,
  "height": 400
}
```

## `lazy`  *(utility · Core · v1.0)*

Defer rendering of an expensive subtree until it enters the viewport (or until explicitly loaded).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `delay` | `number` | no | — | Milliseconds to wait before building, when `trigger` is `delay`. |
| `placeholder` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered while `content` is not yet materialized |
| `content` *(aliases: `child`)* | `Widget | object` | no | — | Inline widget, or `{ source: "ui://..." }` to fetch a remote page fragment. Required when `children` is omitted. |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | A single deferred widget. Alternative to `content` for the simple case. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | no | — | Multiple deferred widgets; runtime wraps them in a linear column. |
| `trigger` | `string` | no | visible | `visible` renders when the widget becomes visible to the user (typically scrolled into view); `immediate` renders on mount; `manual` renders when a `load()` signal is received. |
| `onLoad` | `Action` | no | — | Fired after `content` is materialized |
| `onError` | `Action` | no | — | Fired if `content` fetch fails; `event.error` |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "lazy",
  "placeholder": {
    "type": "box",
    "height": 200,
    "child": { "type": "progressBar" }
  },
  "content": {
    "source": "ui://pages/heavy-component"
  }
}
```

#### `prose_example_1`

```json
{
  "type": "lazy",
  "placeholder": {
    "type": "box",
    "height": 120,
    "child": { "type": "text", "text": "Loading chart…" }
  },
  "content": {
    "type": "chart",
    "chartType": "line",
    "data": "{{salesData}}"
  }
}
```

## `lightbox`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.3)*

Full-screen modal image viewer with pinch-zoom and swipe-between-
images. Used as a tap target on a thumbnail image — opening the
lightbox transitions the thumbnail into the full-screen view.
Pairs naturally with `hero` for the cover-to-detail morph.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `images` | `array<AssetRef>` | yes | — | Image asset list. Each entry is an AssetRef. |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | no | 0 | Index of the image shown first. |
| `allowZoom` | `boolean` | no | true | Enable pinch-zoom (and double-tap-to-zoom). When false the lightbox shows the image at fit-bounds only. |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | no | 4.0 | Maximum zoom factor (1.0 = fit-bounds). |
| `allowSwipe` | `boolean` | no | true | Enable swipe-between-images. When false the lightbox shows only `images[initialIndex]`. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | #FF000000 | Backdrop color behind the image (typically black or theme.scrim). |
| `onIndexChanged` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the user swipes to a new image. `event.index` carries the new index. |
| `onClose` | `Action` | no | — | Fires when the user dismisses the lightbox. |

### Examples

#### `gallery`

```json
{
  "type": "lightbox",
  "images": "{{photos}}",
  "initialIndex": "{{tappedIndex}}",
  "allowZoom": true,
  "maxZoom": 6,
  "onClose": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "lightboxOpen", "value": false
  }
```

## `linear`  *(layout · Core)*

**Aliases:** `row`, `column`

Linear (flex) layout along a single axis. Replaces separate `row` / `column` widgets — use `direction: "horizontal"` or `direction: "vertical"`.

Main-axis sizing: when at least one child is `expanded` / `flexible` / `spacer` (or carries a `flex` value), `linear` expands to fill the available main-axis space so those children can distribute the remainder; otherwise it shrink-wraps its children. Authors can override this with the explicit `mainAxisSize` property.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | no | — | Let children flow onto another line instead of overflowing. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space inside the surface, around its content. |
| `mainAxisSize` | `string` | no | — | `max` fills the parent along `direction`; `min` shrink-wraps. Defaults to `max` when a flex child (`expanded`/`flexible`/`spacer`) is present, otherwise `min`. |
| `direction` *(aliases: `orientation`, `scrollDirection`)* | `string` | yes | vertical | `"horizontal"` or `"vertical"`. |
| `alignment` *(aliases: `crossAxisAlignment`)* | `string` | no | start | Cross-axis alignment: `start`, `center`, `end`, `stretch`. |
| `distribution` *(aliases: `mainAxisAlignment`)* | `string` | no | start | Main-axis distribution: `start` · `center` · `end` · `spaceBetween` · `spaceAround` · `spaceEvenly` (§17.1.3 spells multi-word values in camelCase).  |
| `spacing` *(aliases: `gap`, `itemSpacing`)* | `number` | no | 0 | Gap between children in logical pixels. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | yes | — | Child widgets arranged along `direction`. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "linear",
  "direction": "vertical",
  "alignment": "center",
  "distribution": "start",
  "spacing": 12,
  "children": [
    { "type": "text", "text": "Title" },
    { "type": "text", "text": "Subtitle" }
  ]
}
```

#### `prose_example_1`

```json
{
  "type": "linear",
  "direction": "horizontal",
  "distribution": "spaceBetween",
  "children": [
    { "type": "text", "text": "Left" },
    { "type": "text", "text": "Right" }
  ]
}
```
