## `link`  *(navigation · Core · v1.4)*

**Aliases:** `navLink`

Text that navigates. `route` goes to an internal route; `url` leaves the
application through `navigation.openUrl` (§4.3.3). Exactly one of the two
is set — a link that could mean either is a link whose destination the
author did not decide.

Composable from `inkWell` + `text` + an action, and the composition is
what most documents do today. It loses the link role (assistive technology
announces "button"), the visited/hover affordances, and — for `url` — the
external-destination cue a user needs before leaving the app.

`navLink` is the same widget with `activeWhen` in use: a link that knows
whether it points at where you already are.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `label` | `string` | yes | — | Link text. Use `child` instead when the link wraps richer content. |
| `route` | `string` | no | — | Internal route. Mutually exclusive with `url`. |
| `params` | `object` | no | — | Route parameters. Ignored when `url` is set. |
| `url` | `string` | no | — | External URL, opened per §4.3.3. Mutually exclusive with `route`. |
| `target` | `string` | no | new | Hint for `url` links only; a host with no tabs MAY ignore it. |
| `activeWhen` | `string | binding` | no | — | Route (or expression) that marks this link as the current location. Sets the active style and `aria-current`. |
| `underline` | `string` | no | hover | Underline policy. |
| `icon` | `IconRef` | no | — | Leading icon. |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | Rich content in place of `label`. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `internal`

```json
{ "type": "link", "label": "Orders", "route": "/orders", "activeWhen": "/orders" }
```

#### `external`

```json
{ "type": "link", "label": "Terms", "url": "https://example.com/terms" }
```

**Aliases:** `listView`, `listview`

Scrollable linear collection rendered from an array binding.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |

Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `itemBuilder` | `Widget` | no | — | Template built once per item, with `{{item}}` and `{{index}}` in scope. |
| `itemCount` | `number` | no | — | How many items to build when the list is generated rather than listed. |
| `scrollCacheExtent` | `Dimension` | no | — | Pixels kept built beyond the viewport on each side. |

| `scrollDirection` | `string` | no | — | Scroll axis. |
| `template` | `object` | no | — | Template name to instantiate. |

Responsive widget that inspects the current layout context and picks a child based on media-query conditions. Supports a `then`/`else` expression form and a `breakpoints` map form. The binding engine exposes `{{media.width}}`, `{{media.height}}`, `{{media.orientation}}` inside `condition`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `condition` | `object | binding` | no | — | Boolean expression (string) or constraint object like `{minWidth, maxWidth}`; selects `then` when truthy. |
| `then` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when `condition` is truthy. |
| `else` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when `condition` is falsy. Legacy alias: `orElse`. |
| `breakpoints` | `object` | no | — | Map of breakpoint name → Widget (e.g., `{ "sm": ..., "md": ... }`). |
| `defaultChild` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when no breakpoint matches. |

## `menu`  *(navigation · Core · v1.4)*

Standing list of navigation destinations, optionally nested. Unlike
`popupMenuButton` (a trigger that opens a transient list) this one is part
of the layout — a sidebar or an inline section list.

`navigationRail` covers the icon-rail form on one axis with a flat item
set; this covers nesting, collapsing, and the expanded/collapsed sidebar
that admin screens are built from.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `items` | `array<object>` | yes | — | `{ key, label, icon?, route?, params?, children?, enabled? }`. `children` nests one or more levels; an item with `children` is a group, not a destination. |
| `selectedKey` | `string | binding` | no | — | Two-way bound key of the active item. |
| `openKeys` | `array<string>` | no | — | Two-way bound keys of expanded groups. |
| `mode` | `string` | no | vertical | `inline` expands groups in place; `vertical`/`horizontal` open them as flyouts. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean | binding` | no | — | Collapse to icons only. Labels move into tooltips rather than disappearing. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelect` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `sidebar`

```json
{
  "type": "menu",
  "mode": "inline",
  "selectedKey": "nav.current",
  "items": [
    { "key": "home", "label": "Home", "icon": "home", "route": "/" },
    { "key": "admin", "label": "Admin", "children": [
      { "key": "users", "label": "Users", "route": "/admin/users" }
    ]}
  ]
}
```

## `multiSelect`  *(input · Core · v1.4)*

Dropdown selection of more than one value. Shared rows per §2.6.0;
`binding` holds an **array** of selected values.

Distinct from `checkboxGroup`, which lays every option out at once: this
keeps the closed/summary form of `select` and is what a long option list
needs. Distinct from `select`, which is single-value — the two are kept
apart rather than folded into a `multiple` flag because the bound value
changes shape (scalar vs array), and a flag that silently changes the
type of what lands in state is the kind of thing an author discovers at
runtime.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label shown beside or above the control. |
| `options` *(aliases: `items`)* | `array<Option>` | yes | — | `{ value, label, icon? }` entries. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | — | Shown when nothing is selected. |
| `maxSelections` | `number` | no | — | Upper bound on selected values. Reaching it disables unselected rows rather than silently dropping a pick. |
| `showChips` | `boolean` | no | true | Render selections as removable chips in the closed field. |
| `selectAll` | `boolean` | no | false | Offer a select-all / clear-all control. |
| `searchable` | `boolean` | no | false | Filter options by typing. Filtering never adds values outside `options` — see `combobox` for free entry. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "multiSelect",
  "binding": "form.tags",
  "options": [
    { "value": "sports", "label": "Sports" },
    { "value": "music", "label": "Music" }
  ],
  "maxSelections": 3
}
```

## `otpInput`  *(input · Core · v1.4)*

Fixed-length one-time-code entry. Shared rows per §2.6.0; `binding` holds
the concatenated string, not per-cell values.

This exists because the composed version is reliably broken. A row of
`textInput`s loses: pasting a full code (it lands entirely in the first
cell), forward focus movement on entry and backward on delete, and the
platform's one-time-code autofill, which needs a single field declaring
that intent. None of the three can be recovered by the author.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `length` | `number` | no | 6 | Number of cells. |
| `inputType` | `string` | no | numeric | Restricts accepted characters and selects the on-screen keyboard. |
| `onComplete` | `Action` | no | — | Fired once every digit is filled. Canonical §17.1.4 spelling; the older `autoSubmit` name is still accepted and does the same thing.  |
| `masked` | `boolean` | no | false | Obscure entered characters. |
| `autofill` | `boolean` | no | true | Declare one-time-code autofill to the platform. A runtime without it renders normally rather than failing. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "otpInput",
  "binding": "auth.code",
  "length": 6,
  "autoSubmit": { "type": "tool", "tool": "verifyCode", "params": { "code": "{{auth.code}}" } }
}
```

## `pageView`  *(scroll · Core)*

Full-viewport paged scroll view. Snaps one page per swipe; ideal
for book pages, photo galleries, onboarding flows. Distinct from
`carousel` (partial-viewport, peeking neighbours) — pageView is
always one full page. Each child is rendered as a separate page.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `padEnds` | `boolean` | no | — | Pad the first and last page so they can centre. |
| `pageSnapping` | `boolean` | no | — | Snap to page boundaries when the drag ends. |
| `clipBehavior` | `string` | no | — | How content crossing the bounds is clipped. |
| `direction` | `string` | no | horizontal | Scroll axis. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | yes | — | One child per page. |
| `initialPage` | `number` | no | 0 | Index of the page rendered first. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | no | false | When true the list wraps around — last → first. |
| `scrollPhysics` | `string` | no | clamping | Edge / overscroll behaviour. `bouncing` mirrors iOS rubber-band; `clamping` is the Android-style hard stop; `neverScrollable` disables user dragging (use programmatic page change only).  |
| `allowImplicitScrolling` | `boolean` | no | false | Pre-render the adjacent pages off-screen so subsequent swipes are instant (assistive-technology friendly). Costs memory.  |
| `onPageChanged` | `Action` | no | — | Fires after the active page settles. `event.page` carries the new index. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the visible page changes. `{{event.value}}` carries its index. |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | no | — | When true, run the transition in reverse direction (for back navigation). |
| `scrollDirection` | `string` | no | — | Scroll axis. |

### Examples

#### `book_pages`

```json
{
  "type": "pageView",
  "direction": "horizontal",
  "scrollPhysics": "bouncing",
  "children": [
    { "type": "richText", "spans": [ { "text": "{{book.chapter1}}" } ] },
    { "type": "richText", "spans": [ { "text": "{{book.chapter2}}" } ] }
  ],
  "onPageChanged": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "currentPage", "value": "{{event.page}}"
  }
}
```

## `pagination`  *(navigation · Core · v1.4)*

Page selector for a paged collection. `binding` holds the current page
(1-based).

The composed version is where off-by-one bugs live: first/last bounds,
the ellipsis window, and disabling prev/next at the ends are re-derived
by every author. Stating it once also fixes what a screen reader hears —
"page 3 of 12", not "3".

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `current` | `number` | no | — | Page currently shown, 1-based. |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path holding the current page. 1-based. |
| `total` | `number` | yes | — | Total item count (not page count) — the widget derives pages from `pageSize`. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | no | 20 | Items per page. |
| `siblingCount` | `number` | no | 1 | Page links shown either side of the current page before the trail is elided. |
| `showSizeChanger` | `boolean` | no | false | Offer a page-size selector. |
| `pageSizeOptions` | `array<number>` | no | — | Choices for the size selector. Ignored when `showSizeChanger` is false. |
| `showTotal` | `boolean` | no | false | Render a total-count summary. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{ "type": "pagination", "binding": "list.page", "total": 240, "pageSize": 20 }
```

## `pdfViewer`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Renders a PDF document with page navigation and zoom.

`webView` can display a PDF where the host has a plugin for it, and that is
the substitution to avoid: the document then belongs to the browser, so
page position, zoom, and search are outside the DSL's reach and outside
the app's theme. A viewer widget keeps them addressable.

`src` is an `AssetRef`, so the same document works from a bundle, a URL, a
picked file (`fileInput` writes a `data:` URI), or a server resource.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Fixed height. |
| `src` | `AssetRef` | yes | — | Document source. Any `AssetRef` form. |
| `page` | `number | binding` | no | — | Current page, 1-based. One-way — the embedded viewer reports no page change back. |
| `zoom` | `number | binding` | no | — | Zoom factor; `1.0` is fit-width. One-way — the embedded viewer reports no zoom change back. |
| `showToolbar` | `boolean` | no | true | Render the built-in toolbar. False leaves navigation entirely to bindings. |
| `showPageNav` | `boolean` | no | true | Page stepper within the toolbar. |
| `showZoom` | `boolean` | no | true | Zoom controls within the toolbar. |
| `fit` | `string` | no | width | Initial fit. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onLoad` | — | — |
| `onPageChange` | — | — |
| `onError` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{ "type": "pdfViewer", "src": "bundle://docs/manual.pdf", "page": "{{doc.page}}" }
```

## `popover`  *(dialog · Core · v1.4)*

**Aliases:** `hoverCard`

Transient surface anchored to a trigger. `child` is the trigger; `content`
is what appears.

Distinct from `tooltip` (text only, no focusable content) and from
`customDialog` (modal, centred, takes the whole screen's attention). A
popover keeps the page usable behind it and is positioned against its
anchor, which is the part composition cannot supply: flipping to the other
side when it would overflow the viewport, and returning focus to the
trigger on dismiss.

`hoverCard` is the same widget with `trigger: "hover"`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `content` | `Widget` | yes | — | Surface contents. May contain focusable widgets — that is what separates this from `tooltip`. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Anchor. The popover positions against this widget's box. |
| `open` | `boolean | binding` | no | — | Two-way open state. Bind it to drive the popover from actions instead of the trigger. |
| `trigger` | `string` | no | tap | `manual` means only `open` controls it. |
| `placement` | `string` | no | auto | Preferred side. `auto` picks the side with room; any value flips when it would overflow. |
| `openDelay` | `number` | no | 0 | Milliseconds before opening. Chiefly for `hover`. |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | no | 0 | Milliseconds before closing after the trigger is released. |
| `dismissOnOutside` | `boolean` | no | true | Close when the user interacts outside the surface. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onOpen` | — | — |
| `onClose` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "popover",
  "trigger": "tap",
  "child": { "type": "button", "label": "Details" },
  "content": { "type": "text", "content": "Ships in 2 days" }
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |

| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Track color. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "progressBar",
  "value": 0.65,
  "indicatorType": "linear",
  "color": "#4CAF50",
  "backgroundColor": "#E0E0E0"
}
```

## `qrCode`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Renders a QR code for `value`.

Cannot be composed — the module grid is computed, not laid out. The
definition is small in exchange, and it pairs with the scanning side the
platform already has: a code produced here is the same artefact §8.9 reads
on arrival.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `value` | `string | binding` | yes | — | Encoded payload. A URL, a `ui://` route, or an entry token. |
| `size` | `number` | no | 200 | Edge length in logical pixels. The grid is square. |
| `errorCorrection` | `string` | no | medium | Error-correction level: `low` (7%), `medium` (15%), `quartile` (25%), `high` (30%).  |
| `foregroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Module color. Contrast against `backgroundColor` must stay high enough to scan; a runtime SHOULD refuse to render below it rather than emit an unreadable code. |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Quiet-zone and gap color. |
| `margin` | `boolean` | no | true | Include the quiet zone. Omitting it breaks scanning against busy backgrounds. |
| `logo` | `AssetRef` | no | — | Image centred over the code. Requires a higher `errorCorrection` to stay scannable. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{ "type": "qrCode", "value": "https://example.com/i/42", "size": 240, "errorCorrection": "high" }
```

## `resizable`  *(layout · Advanced · v1.4)*

A box the user can resize by dragging its edges or corners.

Distinct from `splitter`, which divides a fixed area between siblings.
This changes one widget's own size against whatever surrounds it.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Content being sized. |
| `width` | `number | binding` | no | — | Two-way bound width. Bind it to persist the size. |
| `height` | `number | binding` | no | — | Two-way bound height. |
| `minWidth` | `number` | no | — | Lower bound on width. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | no | — | Upper bound on width. |
| `minHeight` | `number` | no | — | Lower bound on height. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | no | — | Upper bound on height. |
| `handles` | `array<string>` | no | — | Draggable edges/corners: `top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`, `topStart`, `topEnd`, `bottomStart`, `bottomEnd`. Omitted means `[bottomEnd]`. |
| `keepAspectRatio` | `boolean` | no | false | Constrain to the starting ratio. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onResize` | — | — |
| `onResizeEnd` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "resizable",
  "width": "{{panel.width}}",
```

## `richText`  *(display · Core)*

Multi-span styled text — paragraph composition for long-form content
(articles, book chapters, captions with inline emphasis or icons).
Each `Span` is either a styled text run or an inline widget; the
paragraph-level `style` provides the base TextStyle that individual
span styles layer on top of.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `textScaleFactor` | `number` | no | — | Multiplier applied to the text size. |
| `spans` | `array<Span>` | yes | — | Inline span list. Each entry is a `Span` (TextSpan or WidgetSpan). See the `Span` $def for the two shapes.  |
| `style` | `TextStyle` | no | — | Paragraph base style applied to every span unless overridden. Use this for a uniform `lineHeight` / `letterSpacing` / `fontFamily` / `color` across the paragraph; per-span styles layer on top via `merge` semantics.  |
| `dropCap` | `DropCap` | no | — | Render the first character of the first `TextSpan` as an enlarged drop cap that the paragraph flows around. Mutually exclusive with `maxLines`.  |
| `textAlign` | `string` | no | start | Alignment for the composed paragraph. |
| `textDirection` | `string` | no | — | Resolution direction for `start`/`end` alignment. |
| `maxLines` | `number` | no | — | Maximum rendered lines. Mutually exclusive with `dropCap`. |
| `overflow` | `string` | no | clip | Overflow behaviour when content exceeds `maxLines`. |
| `softWrap` | `boolean` | no | true | When false, the paragraph never wraps and overflow rules apply at the right edge. |

### Examples

#### `text_run_with_emphasis`

Simple multi-style text run.


```json
{
  "type": "richText",
  "style": { "fontSize": 16, "height": 1.5 },
  "spans": [
    { "text": "Hello " },
    { "text": "{{user.name}}", "style": { "fontWeight": "bold" } },
    { "text": "!" }
  ]
}
```

#### `inline_widget_span`

TextSpan + WidgetSpan mixed (inline icon).


```json
{
  "type": "richText",
  "spans": [
    { "text": "Pressed " },
    { "widget": { "type": "icon", "icon": "favorite", "size": 14 }, "alignment": "middle" },
    { "text": " 12 times" }
  ]
}
```

#### `drop_cap_article`

Article opening with drop cap.


```json
{
  "type": "richText",
  "style": { "fontSize": 17, "height": 1.55 },
  "dropCap": { "lines": 3, "style": { "fontFamily": "serif", "fontWeight": "bold" } },
  "spans": [
    { "text": "Once upon a time, in a land far far away, there lived a runtime that loved its decorations." }
  ]
}
```

## `richTextEditor`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Formatted text entry. Shared rows per §2.6.0.

**The bound value is HTML**, a subset stated in `format` below. That choice
is the whole reason this widget needed a decision rather than a definition:
an editor's value format is a contract every consumer of the document
inherits, and a proprietary delta model would make the content unreadable
to anything but the editor that produced it. HTML is what `richText` and
`markdown` already sit beside, and a host that cannot edit can still
display it.

A runtime MUST sanitise on the way in and on the way out — §7.5 applies to
this value exactly as it applies to any other author-supplied markup. The
editor is not a licence to inject.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `format` | `string` | no | html | Value format. `html` is limited to inline marks (`strong`, `em`, `u`, `s`, `code`, `a`), block elements (`p`, `h1`-`h6`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `blockquote`, `pre`), and `img` whose `src` is an `AssetRef`. Anything else is stripped, not escaped. |
| `toolbar` | `array<string>` | no | — | Controls to show, e.g. `[bold, italic, link, bulletList, heading]`. Omitted means the runtime's default set. A control absent here MUST also be unreachable by keyboard shortcut, or the toolbar lies about what the document can contain. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | — | Shown while empty. |
| `minHeight` | `number` | no | — | Minimum editor height in logical pixels. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | no | — | Character ceiling, counted on the text content rather than the markup. |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired as the document changes. `{{event.value}}` carries the current rich-text value. |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "richTextEditor",
  "binding": "post.body",
  "toolbar": ["bold", "italic", "link", "bulletList"],
  "minHeight": 240
}
```

## `rive`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Plays a Rive animation (`.riv` asset) — the alternative to
`lottieAnimation` when the asset was authored in Rive. State-machine
inputs are driven via `inputs` so the same asset reacts to host
state changes (toggle, scrub, trigger). Distinct from Lottie:
Rive supports interactive state machines, vector deformation, and
smaller binary footprints; Lottie is After Effects-based and
better suited to time-driven motion graphics.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `src` | `AssetRef` | yes | — | Rive asset path (`bundle://...riv`, `https://...riv`, `assets/...riv`). |
| `artboard` | `string` | no | — | Named artboard to render. Defaults to the file's primary artboard. |
| `animation` | `string` | no | — | Named timeline animation. Mutually exclusive with `stateMachine`. |
| `stateMachine` | `string` | no | — | Named state machine. Mutually exclusive with `animation`. |
| `inputs` | `object` | no | — | Map of state-machine input name → value. `boolean` / `number` / `trigger` (set to `true` to fire) — type matches the input's declared type in the Rive file.  |
| `fit` | `string` | no | contain | How the artboard scales within its render bounds. |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` | no | center | Alignment of the artboard within its render bounds. |
| `width` | `Dimension` | no | — | Render width in logical pixels. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Render height in logical pixels. |

### Examples

#### `animated_avatar`

```json
{
  "type": "rive",
  "src": "bundle://avatars/dragon.riv",
  "stateMachine": "Idle",
  "inputs": {
    "happy": "{{user.online}}",
    "wave": "{{justGreeted}}"
  },
  "width": 120,
  "height": 120
}
```

## `scrollAnimated`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Animation driven by scroll position rather than time. Wraps a
child and reads from an ancestor scroll view's offset. Each
`binding` maps a scroll-offset window to a property tween — when
scroll passes through `[fromOffset, toOffset]` the property
interpolates between `fromValue` and `toValue` linearly (or via
`curve`).

Common uses: parallax masthead (image translates 50% scroll
speed), reveal-on-scroll (fade in as element enters viewport),
shrinking title (font scales as user scrolls down).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `bindings` | `array<object>` | yes | — | Per-property scroll bindings. Each entry is `{property, fromOffset, toOffset, fromValue, toValue, curve?}`: - `property` — `opacity` / `scale` / `translateX` /   `translateY` / `rotate`. Other properties may be wired by   runtime extensions. - `fromOffset` / `toOffset` — scroll-position window in   logical pixels. - `fromValue` / `toValue` — interpolated target values for the   property at the window endpoints. - `curve` — optional easing across the window. Defaults to   `linear`.  |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Animated subtree. |

### Examples

#### `parallax_masthead`

```json
{
  "type": "scrollAnimated",
  "bindings": [
    {
      "property": "translateY",
      "fromOffset": 0,
      "toOffset": 240,
      "fromValue": 0,
      "toValue": -120
    }
  ],
  "child": { "type": "image", "src": "{{cover}}", "fit": "cover" }
}
```

## `scrollBar`  *(scroll · Core)*

Wraps a scrollable child with a visible scroll bar.

The runtime MUST provide a shared scroll controller to both the scroll bar and its scrollable child. When `thumbVisibility` or `trackVisibility` is `true`, the controller is required to drive the visibility; omitting it is a runtime error. Authors SHOULD NOT manage the controller manually — the runtime injects it transparently so the child scrollable (`scrollView`, `singleChildScrollView`, `list`, `grid`, `pageView`) binds to the same position.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `thumbVisibility` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the scroll thumb is always visible. |
| `trackVisibility` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the scroll track is always visible. |
| `thickness` | `number` | no | — | Scroll bar thickness. |
| `radius` | `number` | no | — | Scroll bar corner radius. |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | Scrollable child. Required when `children` is omitted. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | no | — | Multiple widgets; runtime wraps them in a linear column. Mutually exclusive with `child`. |

## `scrollView`  *(scroll · Core)*

**Aliases:** `scrollArea`

Scrollable viewport. Two layout modes — pick one per instance:

- **Linear mode** — `child` (single widget) or `children` (wrapped
  in an implicit linear column along `direction`). Simplest for
  everyday scrolling content.
- **Sliver mode** — `slivers` array of `Sliver` primitives. Use
  for collapsing app bars, sticky section headers, parallax
  mastheads, or mixing list/grid sections in one viewport.

The three input slots (`child`, `children`, `slivers`) are
mutually exclusive.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `primary` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether this is the primary scroll view of the page. |
| `direction` | `string` | no | vertical | Scroll axis. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Inner padding around the scrollable content. |
| `scrollPhysics` | `string` | no | clamping | Edge / overscroll behaviour. |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | Single scrolled child. Mutually exclusive with `children` and `slivers`. |

#### `linear_mode`


```json

  "type": "scrollView",
  "slivers": [
    {
      "type": "sliverAppBar",
      "expandedHeight": 240,
      "pinned": true,
      "stretch": true,
      "title": { "type": "text", "text": "Library" },
      "background": { "type": "image", "src": "{{cover}}", "fit": "cover" }
    },
    {
      "type": "sliverList",
      "items": "{{books}}",
      "itemTemplate": { "type": "listItem", "title": "{{item.title}}" }
    }
  ]
}
```

## `splitter`  *(layout · Advanced · v1.4)*

Panes separated by draggable gutters.

Distinct from `resizable`, which resizes one box against the layout around
it. This divides a fixed area between siblings: dragging a gutter takes
space from one pane and gives it to the next, so the total never changes.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | yes | — | Panes, in order. Gutters appear between adjacent panes. |
| `orientation` | `string` | no | horizontal | Direction panes are laid along. |
| `sizes` | `array<number> | binding` | no | — | Pane sizes as fractions summing to 1. Two-way bindable so a layout can be restored. Omitted distributes evenly. |
| `minSizes` | `array<number>` | no | — | Per-pane minimum fractions. A drag stops at them rather than collapsing a pane the author did not mark collapsible. |
| `gutterSize` | `number` | no | 8 | Gutter thickness in logical pixels. Keep it large enough to hit with a finger where touch is possible. |
| `collapsible` | `array<boolean>` | no | — | Per-pane: whether dragging past its minimum collapses it entirely. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onDragEnd` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "splitter",
  "orientation": "horizontal",
  "sizes": [0.3, 0.7],
  "minSizes": [0.15, 0.3],
  "children": [
    { "type": "menu", "items": [] },
    { "type": "text", "content": "Detail" }
  ]
}
```

## `spreadsheet`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.4)*

Editable grid of cells addressed by row and column, with optional formulas.

Distinct from `dataTable`, which presents records: a table's unit is a row
with typed fields, a spreadsheet's unit is a cell with a coordinate. That
difference is why one cannot be a mode of the other — selection, editing,
and paste all address different things.

**Formulas are evaluated by the runtime's expression engine under §7.1**,
not by a spreadsheet language of the DSL's own. A runtime that cannot meet
that sandbox MUST render formulas as their last computed value rather than
evaluating them loosely: a cell that runs arbitrary text is the one place
this widget could become an injection surface.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `data` | `array<array> | binding` | yes | — | Rows of cell values. A cell is a scalar, or `{ value, formula?, format?, style? }` when it carries more than a value. |
| `columns` | `array<object>` | no | — | `{ key?, label?, width?, type?, readOnly? }` per column. Omitted derives columns from the widest row and labels them A, B, C… |
| `rowHeaders` | `boolean` | no | true | Show the row-number gutter. |
| `columnHeaders` | `boolean` | no | true | Show the column-letter header. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | no | true | Allow cell editing. |
| `formulas` | `boolean` | no | false | Evaluate `formula` fields. Off by default — a document that does not need computation should not carry an evaluator. |
| `frozenRows` | `number` | no | 0 | Rows pinned at the top while scrolling. |
| `frozenColumns` | `number` | no | 0 | Columns pinned at the start while scrolling. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | — | — |
| `onCellSelect` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "spreadsheet",
  "data": "{{sheet.rows}}",
  "editable": true,
  "frozenRows": 1,
  "onChange": { "type": "tool", "tool": "setCell", "params": { "r": "{{event.row}}", "c": "{{event.column}}", "v": "{{event.value}}" } }
}
```

## `staggeredGrid`  *(list · Core · v1.3)*

Pinterest-style masonry layout — items keep their intrinsic height
and are packed by column without uniform row alignment. Use for
album / book / portfolio shelves where covers have different
aspect ratios. Distinct from `grid` (uniform row alignment) and
`carousel` (single-axis scrolling).

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `items` | `array | binding` | no | — | Array source. Required when `children` is omitted. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Widget` | no | — | Template rendered per bound item. Required with `items`. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | no | — | Static cells. Mutually exclusive with `items` + `itemTemplate`. |
| `columns` | `number | object` | yes | — | Column count. The object form is a responsive override keyed by form factor (§14.1.1) — `{compact, medium, expanded, large, extraLarge, default}`. |
| `mainAxisSpacing` | `number` | no | 0 | Gap along the scroll axis (between consecutive items in a column). |
| `crossAxisSpacing` | `number` | no | 0 | Gap across the scroll axis (between columns). |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Inner padding around the grid. |
| `scrollDirection` | `string` | no | vertical | Scroll axis. |

### Examples

#### `album_shelf`

```json
{
  "type": "staggeredGrid",
  "items": "{{albums}}",
  "columns": { "default": 2, "md": 3, "lg": 4 },
  "mainAxisSpacing": 12,
  "crossAxisSpacing": 12,
  "padding": { "all": 16 },
  "itemTemplate": {
    "type": "card",
    "child": {
      "type": "linear", "direction": "vertical",
      "children": [
        { "type": "image", "src": "{{item.cover}}", "fit": "cover" },
        { "type": "text",  "text": "{{item.title}}" }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## `stepper`  *(input · Core)*

**Aliases:** `steps`

Step-by-step wizard. Shared `binding` / `value` / `enabled` / `onChange` per §2.6.0 — the bound value is the **active step index** (integer). `binding` and `currentStep` are aliases: when `binding` is set, it takes effect; otherwise `currentStep` is read as a one-way property.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `margin` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space outside the surface. |
| `physics` | `string` | no | — | Scroll response: `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `always`. |
| `steps` | `array<Step>` | yes | — | Each step: `{ title, subtitle?, state?, content, isActive? }`. |
| `currentStep` | `number | binding` | no | 0 | One-way legacy property. Use §2.6.0 `binding` for two-way behavior. |
| `stepperType` | `string` | no | vertical | `vertical` or `horizontal`. |
| `onStepTapped` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when a step header is tapped. Receives `{{event.index}}`. |
| `onStepContinue` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the continue button is pressed. |
| `onStepCancel` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the cancel button is pressed. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "stepper",
  "binding": "wizard.currentStep",
  "steps": [
    { "title": "Account", "content": { "type": "text", "text": "..." } },
    { "title": "Profile", "content": { "type": "text", "text": "..." } }
  ]
}
```

## `tabBar`  *(navigation · Core)*

Horizontal tab selector. Each tab's text field is `label`.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |

| `indicator` | `object` | no | — | Decoration drawn as the selection indicator, replacing the default underline. |
| `indicatorPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space between the indicator and the tab bounds. |
| `indicatorSize` | `string` | no | — | What the indicator spans: `tab` (the whole tab) or `label` (the text only). |
| `indicatorWeight` | `Dimension` | no | — | Thickness of the default underline indicator. |
| `isScrollable` | `boolean` | no | — | Let the tabs scroll horizontally instead of sharing the width. |
| `labelPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space around each tab label. |

| `unselectedLabelColor` | `Color` | no | — | Colour of labels that are not selected. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "tabBar",
  "selectedIndex": "{{activeTab}}",
  "tabs": [
    { "label": "Overview" },
    { "label": "Activity" },
    { "label": "Settings" }
```

## `text`  *(display · Core)*

**Aliases:** `label`

Renders a string. The canonical content field is `text`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `textTransform` | `string` | no | — | Case transform applied before rendering: `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize`, `none`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | no | — | Label announced by a screen reader in place of the content. |
| `semanticsLabel` | `string` | no | — | Label announced by a screen reader in place of the content. |
| `softWrap` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the text breaks at soft line boundaries. |
| `textScaleFactor` | `number` | no | — | Multiplier applied to the text size. |
| `text` *(aliases: `content`)* | `string` | yes | — | Text content. Supports binding expressions. |
| `variant` | `string` | no | — | M3 typography role. The runtime resolves it through `theme.typography.<variant>` (see `05_Theme.md` § 5.4) and uses the result as the base TextStyle. Inline `style` (if present) overrides individual fields on top of the resolved role.  |
| `style` | `TextStyle` | no | — | Inline `TextStyle` overrides (color, fontWeight, fontSize, decoration, shader, shadows, fontFeatures, …). Layered on top of `variant` when both are set. A binding expression `"{{theme.typography.<role>}}"` is also accepted and resolves to the same role's typography object — equivalent to writing `variant: "<role>"`.  |
| `dropCap` | `DropCap` | no | — | Render the first character of `text` as an enlarged drop cap that the surrounding lines flow around (book / magazine ornament). Mutually exclusive with `maxLines`.  |
| `maxLines` | `number` | no | — | Maximum rendered lines. |
| `overflow` | `string` | no | clip | `clip`, `ellipsis`, `fade`, `visible`. |
| `textAlign` | `string` | no | start | `start`, `center`, `end`, `justify` follow the text direction (`start` is right-hand in an RTL locale). `left` and `right` are absolute and do not — they are the way to pin a column of numbers to one side whatever the locale, so they are values, not aliases. |
| `textDirection` | `string` | no | — | Resolution direction for `start`/`end` alignment. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | Measured from real documents (2026-08-04): any literal or binding — the §2.6.0 input contract shape. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "text",
  "text": "Hello {{user.name}}",
  "style": { "fontSize": 16, "fontWeight": "bold", "color": "#333333" }
}
```

## `textInput`  *(input · Core · v1.0)*

**Aliases:** `textField`, `textfield`, `textFormField`, `text-form-field`

Single-line (or multi-line when `maxLines > 1`) text entry. Follows the
shared input contract (spec §2.6.0): when `binding` is set, the runtime
reads the current value from the state path and writes user input back
without requiring an explicit `onChange`. Explicit `value` + `onChange`
override the shorthand.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the input value. |
| `value` | `string | binding` | no | — | One-way initial/display value when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the field accepts user input. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `debounce` | `number` | no | — | Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before `onChange` fires. |
| `textInputAction` | `string` | no | — | Keyboard action key: `done`, `next`, `search`, `send`, `go`, `newline`. |
| `errorText` | `string` | no | — | Error message shown under the field. Overrides validation output. |
| `style` | `TextStyle` | no | — | Text style applied to the label. |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label shown above or floating inside the field. |
| `placeholder` *(aliases: `hint`)* | `string` | no | — | Placeholder shown when the field is empty. |
| `helperText` | `string` | no | — | Helper text shown below the field. |
| `prefixIcon` | `string` | no | — | Icon displayed at the start of the field. |
| `suffixIcon` | `string` | no | — | Icon displayed at the end of the field. |
| `obscureText` | `boolean` | no | false | Hide input characters (passwords). |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | no | false | Whether the field is read-only. |
| `maxLines` | `integer` | no | 1 | Maximum number of visible lines. |
| `maxLength` | `integer` | no | — | Maximum character length enforced at input time. |
| `inputType` | `string` | no | text | Virtual keyboard hint / input semantics. |
| `showToggle` | `boolean` | no | false | Offer a reveal control alongside an obscured field. Ignored unless `obscureText` is true. |
| `defaultCountry` | `string` | no | — | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country seeding the dialling code. Ignored unless `inputType` is `phone`. |
| `validation` | `ValidationConfig` | no | — | Input constraints; see `../../07_Security.md` §7.2.1. |
| `error` | `string | boolean | binding` | no | — | Error state: a message to show, or `true` to mark the field with `errorText`. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | `value: string`, `type: change` | `onChanged`, `change` |
| `onSubmit` | `value: string`, `type: submit` | `submit` |
| `onFocus` | `type: focus` | — |
| `onBlur` | `value: string`, `type: blur` | `blur` |

### Examples

#### `binding_only`

Canonical binding shorthand — runtime hydrates + writes back automatically.


```json
{
  "type": "textInput",
  "label": "Email",
  "binding": "form.email",
  "inputType": "email"
}
```

#### `validation_email`

Shape B validation (rule array).


```json
{
  "type": "textInput",
  "label": "Email",
  "binding": "form.email",
  "validation": [
    { "rule": "required", "message": "Email is required" },
    { "rule": "email",    "message": "Invalid email format" }
  ]
}
```

#### `explicit_value_onChange`

Opts out of binding shorthand — explicit `value` + `onChange`.


```json
{
  "type": "textInput",
  "value": "{{form.query}}",
  "onChange": {
    "type": "state",
    "action": "set",
    "binding": "form.query",
    "value": "{{event.value}}"
  }
}
```

#### `missing_type` — **expected: validation_error** at `#/required/type`

`type` missing — top-level validation error.


```json
{ "label": "Oops" }
```

#### `bad_input_type` — **expected: validation_error** at `#/properties/inputType/enum`

`inputType` must be one of the enum values.


```json
{ "type": "textInput", "inputType": "currency" }
```

## `toggle`  *(input · Core)*

**Aliases:** `switch`

Binary on/off control. Shared `binding` / `value` / `enabled` / `onChange` per §2.6.0; `value` is `boolean`.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path bound two-way to the widget value (§2.6.0). Runtime reads/writes this path without requiring an explicit onChange. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `change` | `Action` | no | — | Legacy alias of `onChange`. |
| `label` | `string` | no | — | Field label shown beside or above the control. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "toggle",
  "binding": "settings.darkMode"
}
```

## `tooltip`  *(display · Core)*

Wrapper that reveals a tooltip on hover or long-press.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `preferBelow` | `boolean` | no | — | Prefer to place the tooltip under the anchor. |
| `richMessage` | `array<object>` | no | — | Message as styled spans, when plain text is not enough. |
| `showDuration` | `number` | no | — | How long the tooltip stays up, in milliseconds. |
| `textStyle` | `TextStyle` | no | — | Text style of the tooltip message. |
| `triggerMode` | `string` | no | — | What raises it: `tap`, `longPress`, `manual`. |
| `verticalOffset` | `Dimension` | no | — | Distance between the anchor and the tooltip. |
| `enableFeedback` | `boolean` | no | — | Play the platform tap sound / haptic on activation. |
| `excludeFromSemantics` | `boolean` | no | — | Keep the surface out of the accessibility tree. |
| `height` | `Dimension` | no | — | Fixed height. |
| `margin` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space outside the surface. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Space inside the surface, around its content. |
| `message` | `string` | yes | — | Tooltip text. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Wrapped widget. |
| `decoration` | `BoxDecoration` | no | — | Animated decoration (color/gradient/border/shadow/image). |
| `textAlign` | `string` | no | — | Alignment for the composed paragraph. |
| `waitDuration` | `number` | no | — | Measured from real documents (2026-08-04): milliseconds before the tooltip appears. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "tooltip",
  "message": "Click to save your changes",
  "child": { "type": "button", "label": "Save" }
}
```

## `transform`  *(animation · Core · v1.3)*

Geometric transformation (rotate, scale, translate) applied to a child.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `rotate` | `number` | no | 0 | Rotation in radians. |
| `scale` | `number | object` | no | 1 | Uniform scale, or `{ x, y }` non-uniform scale. |
| `translate` | `object` | no | — | `{ x, y }` offset in logical pixels. |
| `origin` | `object` | no | { "x": 0.5, "y": 0.5 } | Transform origin as fraction. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | no | false | Animate transform changes. |
| `duration` | `number` | no | 300 | Animation duration in milliseconds. |
| `curve` | `string` | no | easeInOut | Animation curve. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes | — | Child widget. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "transform",
  "rotate": "{{local.isFlipped ? 3.14 : 0}}",
  "scale": "{{local.isHovered ? 1.05 : 1.0}}",
  "animated": true,
  "duration": 300,
  "child": {
    "type": "card",
    "child": { "type": "text", "text": "{{title}}" }
  }
}
```

## `tree`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.0)*

**Aliases:** `treeView`

Hierarchical tree view with expandable nodes.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `checkable` | `boolean` | no | false | Render a checkbox per node. Checked keys bind through `checkedKeys`. |
| `checkedKeys` | `array<string> | binding` | no | — | Two-way bound checked node keys. |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | no | false | Allow reordering/reparenting by drag. Reports through `onDrop`; the widget does not mutate the tree itself. |
| `data` | `array | binding` | yes | — | Hierarchical data; each node MAY carry a `children` array. Literal array or binding. |
| `childrenKey` | `string` | no | children | Field name of the children array |
| `indentation` | `number` | no | 24 | Per-depth horizontal indentation in logical pixels. |
| `itemPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | no | — | Padding applied inside every tree row (expandable and leaf). Defaults to `{vertical: 4, right: 8}`. Adjust the vertical component to change row height / density. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Widget` | no | — | Template rendered per node; `{{item}}` is node data. Falls back to a default list-item renderer when omitted. |
| `expandable` | `boolean` | no | true | Allow expand/collapse |
| `initiallyExpanded` | `boolean` | no | false | Expand all nodes on mount |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | no | false | Whether a node can be selected by tap. |
| `showLines` | `boolean` | no | true | Draw connector lines between parent and leaf nodes. |
| `selectedColor` | `Color` | no | — | Background color of the currently selected row. |
| `lineColor` | `Color` | no | — | Color of connector lines when `showLines` is true. |
| `width` | `number` | no | — | Fixed widget width in logical pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | no | — | Fixed widget height in logical pixels. |
| `onDrop` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when a dragged node is released on another. `event.item` is the node that moved, `event.target` the node it was released on, and `event.position` one of `before` / `inside` / `after` — which edge of the target it landed on. The widget does not mutate the tree; the document decides what a move means.  |
| `onNodeTap` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on node tap |
| `onSelect` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when a node is selected (requires `selectable: true`). Event payload is the node object. |
| `onExpand` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on node expand; `event.id` |
| `onCollapse` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on node collapse; `event.id` |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "tree",
  "data": "{{fileStructure}}",
  "expandable": true,
  "childrenKey": "children",
  "itemTemplate": {
    "type": "listItem",
    "title": "{{item.name}}",
    "leading": { "type": "icon", "icon": "{{item.icon}}" }
  },
  "onNodeTap": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "selectedNodeId", "value": "{{event.id}}"
  }
}
```

## `view`  *(utility · Composition · v1.4)*

Embeds a definition sourced from anywhere — including another MCP origin — at
this point in the tree. The consumer side of composition: `11_Bundle_Metadata.md`
§11.9 `dashboard` declares how an app presents itself *when embedded*; `view`
is how an app *embeds*. See [`01_Core_Concepts.md`](01_Core_Concepts.md) §1.9
for `DefinitionSource` and the origin-scope rule.

When `source` names an origin, that origin becomes the ambient origin for the
embedded subtree: its `tool` calls, resource reads, subscriptions, state,
storage, and permissions all scope to it (§1.9.5, §7.10, §8.8). This is what
lets a definition authored with no knowledge of any embedder render unmodified
and still reach its own server.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `source` | `DefinitionSource` | yes | — | What to render — an inline definition, a `ui://` URI on the current origin, a qualified `{ $ref, from }` reference to another origin, or a binding to a definition held in state. See §1.9.1.  |
| `props` | `object` | no | — | Values merged into the embedded definition's initial state. The ONLY channel from embedder to embedded — an embedded view never implicitly reads the embedder's state (§7.10). One-way: mutations inside the embedded scope do not propagate back.  |
| `fallback` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered when the source cannot be resolved (origin unreachable, resource missing, malformed definition). Absent = a generic unavailable indicator. |
| `loading` | `Widget` | no | — | Rendered while the source resolves. Absent = a generic progress indicator. |
| `onError` | `Action` | no | — | Fired with `{{event.error}}` when resolution fails. Failure is scoped to this view — sibling views and the embedding page continue to render (§2.13.1). |
| `theme` | `string` | no | inherit | `inherit` (default) renders the embedded definition under the embedder's theme so a composed screen looks like one product. `own` honours the embedded definition's own theme — appropriate when embedding a full third-party application rather than a summary tile.  |

## `visibility`  *(layout · Core)*

Shows or hides a child with optional state preservation and replacement content.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `maintainAnimation` | `boolean` | no | — | Keep animations running while hidden. |
| `maintainInteractivity` | `boolean` | no | — | Keep the subtree interactive while hidden. |
| `visible` | `boolean | binding` | no | true | Whether the child is visible. Defaults to `true` when omitted. |
| `maintainSize` | `boolean` | no | false | Keep space allocated when hidden. |
| `maintainState` | `boolean` | no | false | Preserve `child` state when hidden. Does not affect `replacement`, which is built fresh each time it is shown. |
| `replacement` | `Widget` | no | — | Widget shown in place of `child` when `visible` is `false`. When absent, the child is simply hidden in-place (respecting `maintainSize` / `maintainState`). |
| `child` | `Widget` | no | — | Primary widget. Required when `children` is omitted. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | no | — | Multiple widgets; runtime wraps them in a linear column. Mutually exclusive with `child`. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "visibility",
  "visible": "{{showControls}}",
  "maintainState": true,
  "child": { "type": "button", "label": "Hide me" }
}
```

## `voiceInput`  *(input · Client · v1.4)*

Speech captured from the microphone, transcribed into `binding`.

**Client Profile, not Core** — and the line is worth stating because
`fileInput` sits on the other side of it. Picking a file is one act of
choosing, and the choosing is the consent. A microphone is a continuous
capture of the room, including whoever else is in it, so it belongs behind
the permission system (§8.4) with a grant the user can see and revoke.

There is no composition that reaches it: microphone access is a host
capability, so without this widget a document cannot express the intent at
all.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `binding` | `string` | no | — | State path receiving the transcript. |
| `value` | `string | number | boolean | object | array` | no | — | One-way initial/display value (§2.6.0). Literal or `{{path}}`; used when `binding` is not set. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | true | Whether the widget accepts user input (§2.6.0). Default `true`. |
| `onChange` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when the widget value changes (§2.6.0). Event payload exposes `event.value`. |
| `language` | `string` | no | — | BCP 47 tag. Omitted uses the host locale. |
| `continuous` | `boolean` | no | false | Keep listening after a pause instead of stopping at the first result. |
| `interimResults` | `boolean` | no | false | Write partial transcripts as they arrive. The binding then changes many times per utterance — bind a separate path if the final text is what the document acts on. |
| `maxDuration` | `number` | no | — | Seconds before capture stops on its own. A microphone with no ceiling is a microphone left on. |
| `showWaveform` | `boolean` | no | true | Render live input level. This is the user's only continuous evidence that capture is running, so a runtime SHOULD keep some indicator even when this is false. |

### Events

| Name | Payload | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `onStart` | — | — |
| `onResult` | — | — |
| `onEnd` | — | — |
| `onError` | — | — |

### Examples

#### `basic`

```json
{
  "type": "voiceInput",
  "binding": "form.note",
  "language": "ko-KR",
  "maxDuration": 60
}
```

## `webView`  *(advanced · Advanced · v1.0)*

Embedded web view.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `url` | `string` | no | null (if html set) | URL to load |
| `html` | `string` | no | null (if url set) | Raw HTML content — alternative to `url` |
| `allowNavigation` | `boolean` | no | true | Allow link navigation within the view |
| `enableJavaScript` | `boolean` | no | true | Enable JavaScript |
| `enableZoom` | `boolean` | no | true | Allow pinch-to-zoom |
| `width` | `number` | no | — | Widget width |
| `height` | `number` | no | — | Widget height |
| `onPageStarted` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when loading starts |
| `onPageFinished` | `Action` | no | — | Fired when loading finishes |
| `onError` | `Action` | no | — | Fired on load error; `event.error` |
| `backgroundColor` | `Color` | no | — | Legacy alias of `color`. |

### Examples

#### `prose_example_0`

```json
{
  "type": "webView",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "allowNavigation": true,
  "enableJavaScript": true,
  "enableZoom": true,
  "width": 600,
  "height": 400,
  "onPageStarted": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "webViewLoading", "value": true
  },
  "onPageFinished": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "webViewLoading", "value": false
  },
  "onError": {
    "type": "state", "action": "set",
    "binding": "webViewError", "value": "{{event.error}}"
  }
}
```

## `wrap`  *(layout · Core)*

Flow layout that wraps children to the next line when they exceed available width/height.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `click` | `Action` | no | — | Action fired when the widget is tapped. Runtime wraps the widget in a gesture surface and dispatches the action on tap. Widget-local activation surfaces (`button.onTap`, `iconButton.onTap`, `richText.spans[].onTap`, …) remain canonical for those widgets and are NOT replaced by `click`; `click` is the universal fallback for widgets that have no dedicated activation slot.  |
| `tooltip` | `string` | no | — | Hover / long-press tooltip text. Runtime wraps the widget in a `Tooltip` surface.  |
| `runAlignment` | `string` | no | — | How the runs (lines) are aligned along the cross axis. |
| `verticalDirection` | `string` | no | — | Order children are laid out vertically: `down` or `up`. |
| `clipBehavior` | `string` | no | — | How content crossing the bounds is clipped. |

| `runSpacing` | `number` | no | 0 | Gap between runs. |
| `alignment` | `string` | no | start | Alignment within a run. |
| `children` | `array<Widget>` | yes | — | Children to wrap. |
| `crossAxisAlignment` | `string` | no | — | Legacy alias of `alignment`. |
| `textDirection` | `string` | no | — | Resolution direction for `start`/`end` alignment. |
